detail: The initial parallel Storybook artifact redirection ran before the artifact directory existed and exited without issuing either download. After the directory existed, both read-only downloads were issued. No hosted job or test was retried or changed.

The first assembly verifier used human-readable git diff names; Git quoted the original Unicode apostrophe in an artifact member path, so the prefix assertion stopped. NUL-delimited paths independently showed all476 files under the reserved archive prefix, correct parent f59 and no candidate mutation. The final verifier uses git diff --name-only -z. This is a local evidence-verifier correction, not a test/CI failure or retry.
